steps.title: Breed ICR mice under SPF conditions
steps.instruction: Breed ICR male and female mice separately (1–5 mice per cage) in a specific‑pathogen‑free room set to 23 ± 1 °C, 40%–60% humidity, with lights on at 5 am and off at 7 pm; provide ad libitum food and water.

steps.title: House 8‑week mice for mating
steps.instruction: Place 8‑week‑old male and female mice together in a cage between 9 am and 10 am; suspend food and water during this hour.

steps.title: Observe mounting behavior and confirm ejaculation
steps.instruction: Watch the female for mounting; if no mounting occurs within ~10 min, replace the male or female. Confirm ejaculation by the male’s temporary rigidity and anteroposterior movement of the loins while holding the female.

steps.title: Check for copulatory plug
steps.instruction: Lift the base of the female’s tail and examine the vaginal opening with tweezers for a copulatory plug; the plug appears within minutes after confirmed ejaculation.

steps.title: Collect post‑ejaculatory uterine fluid
steps.instruction: Using scissors, tweezers and gloves, euthanize the female by cervical dislocation, disinfect the abdomen with 70 % ethanol, open the skin and peritoneum, remove bladder and surrounding adipose tissue, cut the endocervix, excise a small uterine piece, and aspirate the uterine fluid into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube with a P‑200 pipette (≈5 min total).

substeps.instruction: Place scissors, tweezers and gloves on the bench.
Cervical‑dislocate the female (hold tail base, grip neck with thumb and index finger, pull both sides).
Disinfect abdomen with 70 % ethanol and cut skin with large scissors.
Pull skin apart to expose peritoneum.
Cut peritoneum with small scissors; locate V‑shaped uterus, oviducts and ovaries using tweezers.
Remove bladder and surrounding fat with small scissors and tweezers.
Cut the endocervix with small scissors and hold with tweezers.
Clear uterus of fat and blood with tweezers and Kimwipes; excise a small uterine segment.
Collect the eUF into a 1.5 mL tube using a P‑200 pipette.

steps.title: Dilute UF and eUF for protein assay
steps.instruction: Dilute each UF and eUF sample 10‑fold and 30‑fold with distilled water; if eUF is viscous, add extra distilled water before pipetting.

steps.title: Prepare BSA standard dilution series
steps.instruction: Using 2 mg/mL bovine serum albumin (BSA) stock, make standards of 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.0625 and 0.03125 mg/mL in distilled water.

steps.title: Perform BCA protein assay
steps.instruction: Add UF/eUF dilutions and BSA standards to a 96‑well plate, run the Pierce BCA kit according to the manufacturer, read absorbance on a SpectraMax iD5, and generate a calibration curve (absorbance vs concentration) in Excel.

steps.title: Adjust protein samples to assay concentration
steps.instruction: Using the calibration curve, set UF and eUF to 1 µg/µL by adding 6× sample buffer and distilled water as needed; then store the adjusted samples at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 8 % acrylamide gel
steps.instruction: Assemble the gel caster with seal gasket and clips, insert the comb, mark 5 mm below the comb, then prepare stacking and separation gel solutions in 15 mL tubes, add APS, cast gels, and store at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Set seal gasket on glass plates and clamp with clips.
Insert comb; draw a line 5 mm below the comb tip.
Wear gloves; pour stacking and separation gel solutions into separate 15 mL tubes.
Add 25 µL of 25 % (w/v) APS to the separation gel solution and mix.
Immediately pour the separation gel (with APS) into the caster up to the mark.
Add 1 mL distilled water with a P‑1000 pipette on top of the separation gel.
When the gel polymerizes, tilt the caster and remove excess water with Kimwipes.
Add 12.5 µL of 25 % (w/v) APS to the stacking gel solution and mix.
Pour the stacking gel (with APS) into the caster, re‑insert the comb, and allow to polymerize.
Cover the solidified gel with plastic wrap and store at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: To each 12.5 µL of UF/eUF (from step 8), add 5 µL of 8 M urea in distilled water, incubate at 95 °C for 5 min, then add 1 µL of 6× sample buffer.

steps.title: Load gel and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Place the hardened gel in the electrophoresis chamber, fill with running buffer, rinse wells with a P‑200 pipette, load 18.5 µL of each sample (including urea‑treated sample and marker mixture), load 18.5 µL of 1× sample buffer with urea into empty wells, and run at Tris‑Gly/PAGEL mode for 80 min.

substeps.instruction: Remove comb and clips from the gel caster; insert the gel into the electrophoresis system.
Fill the chamber with running buffer (Tris‑Gly buffer).
Rinse each well with a P‑200 pipette (200 µL tip).
Load each sample: 12.5 µL sample + 5 µL 8 M urea = 18.5 µL.
Load protein molecular weight marker: 10 µL marker + 2.5 µL 1× buffer + 1 µL 6× buffer + 5 µL 8 M urea = 18.5 µL.
Load 1× sample buffer containing urea into empty wells (12.5 µL 1× buffer + 1 µL 6× buffer + 5 µL urea = 18.5 µL).
Run electrophoresis: Tris‑Gly/PAGEL mode, 1 gel, 80 min.

steps.title: Stain and decolorize gel
steps.instruction: Incubate the gel in Coomassie Brilliant Blue R‑250 staining solution for 1 h at 25–27 °C on a shaker, then wash with tap water and destain with CBB decolorizing solution.

steps.title: Fix uterus for histology
steps.instruction: After dissection (steps 2–6 of collection), ligate the upper vaginal cervix with silk thread, place the reproductive tract between filter papers, and fix in Bouin’s solution overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Cryoprotect and embed tissue
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed tract with 1× PBS for 10 min at room temperature, then incubate in 30 % (w/v) sucrose overnight at 4 °C; cut the uterus, embed in a cryomold with OCT compound, freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Section and stain slides
steps.instruction: Cut 5 µm cryosections, mount on glass slides, dry at room temperature, wash with tap water 10 min, stain with hematoxylin for 5 min, rinse, stain with eosin for 2 min, rinse, then sequentially dip in 70 %, 80 %, 90 %, 100 % (twice) ethanol, xylene (twice) for 30 s each.

steps.title: Mount slides and capture images
steps.instruction: Apply a few drops of New M·X mounting medium, cover with a 24 mm × 50 mm cover glass, and acquire bright‑field images of the uterus with a microscope.
